native_context: PostgreSQL row-security policy and runtime-role isolation
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: PostgreSQL row-security policy and runtime-role isolation — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read table policies, USING/WITH CHECK, table ownership, bypass roles, security-definer functions and connection-pool tenant context. Identify the real application role.
controls.controlled_verification: In a disposable database run A/B synthetic row reads and writes as the actual-equivalent application role, then switch tenant context over a reused connection. Compare with an entitled role. Test both old-row visibility and proposed-row acceptance where the operation requires them.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A superuser or table owner result may not represent the application role. Testing only SELECT does not establish INSERT/UPDATE confinement, and a source policy without effective role settings does not prove enforcement.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply policies to intended roles/actions and establish/reset trustworthy tenant context on pool reuse. Retest denied rows/writes, legitimate A/B operations and the original connection lifecycle.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
